seats.text: The implementation is complete: `format.ts` implements C-printf-style `format(fmt, ...args)` using exact BigInt arithmetic (decomposing each double into mantissa×2^exponent, then round-half-to-even via exact fraction comparison) so all rounding matches the true binary value per the README — verified against tricky cases like `%.0f` of 0.5/1.5/2.5, `%.2f` of 2.675, `-0`, inf/nan, `#o` of 0, and `%g` trimming.
